input.prompt: Dramatic YouTube thumbnail image, stylized 3D CGI render in the same simulation style as the reference image (clean 3D, saturated colors), 16:9. Scene: an offshore rocket launch platform on the equator at the exact moment Earth spins so fast that gravity disappears. IMPORTANT: keep the whole upper-left third of the image as plain sky with no objects, so a text can be placed there. No text, no letters, no watermark. The ocean itself is lifting off: massive columns and blobs of seawater floating up into a dark red-orange sky. The platform deck is cracking and tilting, a rocket on the red launch tower breaking loose. Dozens of recognizable people in colorful clothes floating helplessly upward, some holding on to railings with their legs in the air. Close-up foreground: a woman in a yellow raincoat floating, looking terrified at the camera. Colorful containers flying. Epic, chaotic, very dramatic.
